propositions: 108 tickets in the store carry Success Criteria as plain bullets instead of Acceptance Criteria checkboxes, making them invisible to AC item counting and blocking verification.

The migration script must rewrite Success Criteria blocks into Acceptance Criteria checklist items via rebar.edit_ticket, preserving auditability and handling both heading orders without duplication or corruption.

Plan-review attestations become stale when ticket descriptions change; the script processes closed tickets by default and requires an explicit flag to touch open/in-progress tickets to avoid silently invalidating in-flight claims.
The migration must be idempotent, order-agnostic, handle qualified headings (with parenthetical qualifiers), and must not corrupt tickets with pre-existing duplicate AC headings.
All 106 migrated tickets must return _count_ac_items >= 1 post-migration, and no Success Criteria heading should remain in the live store outside prose mentions.
